title: Add RAG agent tool-calling examples and docs update
author: Priya Menon
description: Motivation: Provide developer-first, runnable examples and quickstarts for building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) agents that use the new tool-calling API. These examples are intended to lower onboarding time for external developers and internal teams evaluating agent patterns (search + tool invocation + structured output). This PR adds Python and TypeScript example apps, RAG agent templates, a docs quickstart, and updates the docs site configuration. Checklist: - [x] Add Python RAG agent example demonstrating tool calls (search + external API) - [x] Add TypeScript RAG agent demo and lightweight frontend sample - [x] Add agent templates (openai-compatible / redwood-tooling) - [x] Add quickstart docs + code snippets to docs site - [x] Add integration tests for example harness - [x] Run lint/docs build and fix issues Summary of changes and rationale: The new examples show common patterns: 1) creating a retrieval pipeline with Redwood embeddings + simple FAISS-backed store, 2) wiring a tool registry (search, calendar, HTTP-fetch) exposed via the tool-calling interface, 3) using structured output for safe downstream parsing, and 4) graceful fallback to a smaller local model when hosted capacity is constrained. The docs quickstart walks users from sign-up -> API key -> running the Python example locally, and includes guidance on batching/caching settings for production. Commit summary: - Add docs quickstart and initial templates - Add python rag agent example and test harness - Add ts example and lightweight demo front-end - Fix lint and test failures after reviewer feedback Files changed (high level): - docs/guides/rag/agent-tool-calling.md (new quickstart & examples guide) - examples/agents/tool-calling/basic_rag_agent.py (runnable python example) - examples/agents/tool-calling/js/basic_rag_agent.ts (typescript example + comments) - examples/agent-templates/openai_compatible.json (agent template for quickstarts) - tests/examples/test_rag_agent_integration.py (integration smoke tests) - docs/site/content/quickstarts/rag-agent.md (site page) - mkdocs.yml (register new quickstart routes + nav) - examples/frontend/rag-demo/package.json (tiny demo app deps) Review conversation (summary): - Diego: asked for clearer defaults for credentials and suggested a shorter python README with copy-paste commands. Author replied with inline README updates and added environment variable examples. - Maya: flagged potential race in the test harness (flaky on CI) and requested a mockable HTTP tool interface. Author updated tests to use a deterministic local tool stub and added comments. - Tomasz: requested example use of structured output schema and suggested adding a small JSON schema file to the template; author included schema and a parsing helper in the python example. CI and merge: Initial CI run: docs build and unit lint passed, integration tests failed on flaky network call. After replacing external calls with the local stub the tests became stable; final CI: all checks passed. Merge method: squash and merge. Notes for reviewers/operators: examples are intentionally minimal and documented; production-readiness guidance is included in the quickstart.
